  • Method Details

    • setPaths

      public void setPaths(String paths)
      The preferred method for showing or not showing content is checking if a user can access a given path/s. If the user can access all of the supplied paths, the filter is fulfilled.
      Parameters:
      paths - The comma-separated list of paths that will be evaluated, in the current server, with an AND operation.

    • setPolicies

      public void setPolicies(String policies)
      An alternative way of filtering content is to directly specify the "policies" that can access to the content. If the user has one of the policies, he will be able to access. Since this is more implementation dependent that the path-based filter, its use is not as recommended as the other one.
      Parameters:
      policies - The comma-separated list of policies that will be matched with an OR operation.

    • setUrl

      public void setUrl(String url)
      And yet another way. Pass an URL that will be parsed with a java.net.URL class for a host and a path. This enables checking of non-local permissions.
      Parameters:
      policies - The url to check

    • doStartTag

      public int doStartTag()
      Hook method called by the taglib container at the start of the tag. We respond EVAL_BODY_TAG, meaning that we want the body of the tag to be evaluated (the "then" and "else" tags probably are there).
      Specified by:
      doStartTag in interface javax.servlet.jsp.tagext.Tag
      Overrides:
      doStartTag in class javax.servlet.jsp.tagext.BodyTagSupport
      Returns:
      What to do after... EVAL_BODY_TAG

    • doAfterBody

      public int doAfterBody() throws javax.servlet.jsp.JspTagException
      Hook method called by the taglib container at the end of the tag body, and after all of it has been evaluated. We first write out the body content, and then call SKIP_BODY to avoid further body evaluations (as would be the case, for example, of a loop tag).
      Specified by:
      doAfterBody in interface javax.servlet.jsp.tagext.IterationTag
      Overrides:
      doAfterBody in class javax.servlet.jsp.tagext.BodyTagSupport
      Returns:
      What to do after... SKIP_BODY
      Throws:
      javax.servlet.jsp.JspTagException

    • userEnabled

      protected boolean userEnabled()
      This method, intended to be used by children tags ThenTag and ElseTag, provides them with the info if the user belonged or not to the policies and hence show or hide their bodies.
      Returns:
      Is the user enabled to see this?
